answer_1.quote: We extend the original seq-to-seq task defined in SCAN to a new, seq-to-3seq task.
answer_1.outputs: action sequences and two auxiliary sequences

answer_2.quote: On the three MCD splits, the CGPS-Transformer that predicts the auxiliary sequences achieves a perfect test-set performance of 100% accuracy, as compared to 7.66%, 3.25%, and 6.12% from the same model but without the auxiliary sequence prediction tasks.
